description: 43-band spectral film emulation engine with multiple film stock presets and full GPU acceleration.
_tagComment: releaseTagPattern pins this catalog entry to the 2.x line. The same release repo also hosts the PhotoChemist 3.0 Beta line (v3.* tags, PhotoChemist3Beta-* assets) served by docs/plugins/photochemist3beta/. Without this filter the newest v3 prerelease would become this entry's beta head and its assets would (partially) match the loose patterns below.
_demoComment: This entry keeps serving the LAST 2.x demo (v2.7.0) and must stay pinned to it — do NOT bump it to the 3.0 demo. The 3.0 demo installs as PhotoChemist3Beta.ofx.bundle / com.dec18studios.PhotoChemist3Beta and is served by docs/plugins/photochemist3beta/; pointing this entry at it would break, because apply_demo_override() in installer.rs swaps only downloadUrl/sha256/version while bundleName still comes from the assetRules below (PhotoChemist.ofx.bundle) — a name that archive does not contain, so it would fail at install. The v2.7.0 demo zip roots at PhotoChemist.ofx.bundle / com.dec18studios.PhotoChemist, which is why it is safe here. The cards are independent, so a user can still pull the 2.x demo from this one while the website and the 3.0 Beta card offer only 3.0. CONSEQUENCE: the public PhotoChemist-Demo v2.7.0 release is load-bearing — deleting it breaks this entry AND the generator, which throws when it cannot resolve the digest. sha256 is resolved live from the release's asset.digest (pin version + downloadUrl only); keep the explicit /releases/download/<tag>/ URL form, since the resolver asserts on it and a /releases/latest/download/ URL would both fail that parse and silently point this 2.x entry at the 3.0 demo.
